name: Digital Delay: PPPCCC's bright, clean delay of up to 5.4 s, for the delay slot
description: The first real effect of model27's effect slots (notes/68 §18): PPPCCC's digital delay from their Model:Cycles 1.13 Mods 2.0.0, ported to an effect package, the sound theirs bit for bit. The opposite of the dark stock delay: bright and clean, up to 5.4 s, each repeat a little thinner in the lows (a high-pass of about 240 Hz and a low-pass of about 12.8 kHz in the feedback). Mono, the same repeat on both outputs. Time and Fdbk keep their knobs; the line is the delay slot's (1 MiB).

uses.name: Digital
uses.why: an effect of the delay slot: called as the stock delay 0x40057488 is, (out, in, P + 428), when the playing pattern chooses id 1; its line of 262 144 frames is the slot's

emulation.pattern: notes/68 §17: instructions per block of the process called alone after its reset (the reset counted apart), on the OS 1.13 in tools/emu/test_fxslot.py section 6 (mcengine.py's counter): noise of +-2^28 into both channels, Time 0 and Fdbk 96 for the delay, Size 64 and Tone 96 for the reverb (x 256), the first block, then the mean and maximum over 21 blocks after 32 more

unchanged: the stock delay, whenever the playing pattern has not chosen Digital
